paraphrase: The burden is the five aggregates of clinging; the bearer of the burden is the person (puggala) of such a name and clan; the taking up of the burden is craving; the laying down of the burden is the remainderless fading and cessation of that craving.
notes: Sutta id and segment range checked in the local bilara-data copy (Mahāsaṅgīti root text, read alongside Sujato's CC0 English); paraphrase by U36 (skeleton phase, fidelity not yet checked). Later cited by the Pudgalavādins (U38) for the reality of the person; Theravāda reads 'person' as a convention.
